story.title: Pilot Makes Pancakes
paragraphs_en: Pilot is in the kitchen. He wants to make pancakes for breakfast. Mom helps him find the flour and eggs.
Pilot puts flour in a big bowl. He cracks two eggs. The eggs go into the bowl too. He adds milk and mixes everything.
Mom turns on the stove. Pilot pours the mix into the pan. The pancake gets golden and smells good. He flips it with a big smile.
The pancakes are ready! Pilot puts honey on top. He eats his pancakes and feels very happy.
paragraphs_vi: Pilot o trong bep va muon lam banh pancake cho bua sang.
Pilot cho bot vao to, dap hai qua trung, them sua va tron deu.
Me bat bep, Pilot do bot vao chao va lat banh.
Banh da san sang, Pilot them mat ong va an rat vui.
story.trivia_vi: Me thuong giup con lam banh pancake vao bua sang cuoi tuan o nha Felix.
